Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Wall Sconce Light, 13.08"H, Oil-Rubbed Bronze
Colors: Oil-rubbed Bronze
A oil-rubbed bronze base and clear glass shade are the perfect example of industrial design. This sconce is sleek and subtle enough to blend with any style while still offering its modern charm wherever it is placed. Bright light is able to flow from the clear shade, making it a great addition wherever you need it. 7.76"W x 9.06"D x 13.08"H Metal construction with an oil-rubbed bronze finish and a clear glass shade The oil-rubbed bronze finish accents the mid-century design to add a stylish element to your home. Includes 1 S60 60-watt maximum vintage incandescent bulb Assemble in 15 minutes or less Indoor use only
